data.name: MindEscape
data.detailed_description:
Discover Who You Really Are

MindEscape is not your typical personality test. Instead of endless questionnaires, you'll navigate through beautifully crafted 3D rooms filled with puzzles, mysteries, and unique scenarios. Your choices, reaction times, and problem-solving approaches create a comprehensive behavioral profile based on the Big Five personality model (OCEAN).

How It Works

Explore interconnected rooms, each featuring carefully designed challenges that naturally reveal your:

  • Personality Traits: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism

  • Problem-Solving Style: How you approach challenges under pressure

  • Behavioral Patterns: Your authentic reactions without social desirability bias

  • Communication Preferences: Leadership tendencies and collaborative instincts

Why MindEscape Differs

✓ No Bias: Real behavioral data from gameplay, not self-reported answers
✓ Engaging Experience: Enjoy 10-minute sessions in visually immersive environments
✓ AI-Powered Analysis: Advanced machine learning provides objective, scientifically-validated insights
✓ Authentic Results: Designed to minimize manipulation—your gameplay reveals your true nature
✓ Comprehensive Reports: Detailed personality profiles you can download and share

Perfect For

  • Self-discovery: Understand your personality and strengths

  • Career planning: Identify roles that match your natural style

  • Team building: See how your personality complements others

  • Research: Contribute to ongoing behavioral science studies

Features

  • 3D escape room environments

  • Multiple interconnected rooms with unique themes

  • Puzzle-solving challenges designed by psychologists and AI scientists

  • Behavioral tracking and analysis

Get Started Today: Play MindEscape, unlock your personality insights, and see how you compare. The only question is: are you ready to discover who you really are?

data.legal_notice:
INFORMATION ON DATA PROCESSING

We inform you that the processing of your personal data is governed by the terms and conditions set out in the provisions of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 and the relevant Greek and EU legislation on the protection of personal data, namely, mainly Law 4624/2019 and Law 3471/2006.
Controller
The controller is the company with the name "RealMint IKE", with VAT number 802092784 and VAT number
169788806000, with registered office at St. Kazantzidi 47, Pylaia, Thessaloniki and its contact details: Tel.:
2310998402, e-mail: info@realmint.ai.
What personal data is collected through the application?
During the initial registration in the RealMint application, your name, surname, date of birth and e-mail are registered, and a unique personal code is created for each use, through which you open your personal page/tab.
Why are your data collected through the application and on what legal basis are they subject to
processing
We inform you that the processing of said data is for the identification of users who
participate in the evaluation process with a psychometric game used when selecting
candidates for jobs. This processing is necessary for the evaluation and if the user of the data does not
consent, it will not be possible to process them and automated
evaluation. The lawfulness of the processing is based, among others, on article 6 par. 1 point a of
Regulation (EU) 2016/679, as the processing takes place on a voluntary basis.
How long is your personal data kept?
The data collected through the application is kept for a period of 3 (three) years.
Who are the recipients of personal data?
The recipients of your personal data are the respective employers to whom the user submits a job application. The controller will not transfer your personal data to a third country outside the European Economic Area.

Technical and organizational data security measures
Our company takes the appropriate technical and organizational data security measures to ensure the confidentiality, processing and protection of your data against accidental or unlawful destruction, accidental loss, alteration, unauthorized disclosure or access and any other form of unlawful processing.
What rights do you have as a data subject? The data subject has the following rights: a) To request information about the categories of your personal data that we hold and process, their origin, the purposes of their processing, the categories of recipients, the period of their retention and your related rights (right of access), b) To request the correction and/or completion of your personal data, so that it is complete and accurate (right of rectification), c) To request the restriction of the processing of your data (right to restriction), d) To object to any further processing of your personal data (right to object)., e) To request the deletion of his personal data (right to be forgotten) under certain conditions, such as when the data is no longer necessary, you have withdrawn your consent, the data has been unlawfully processed, f) To request the transfer of your data to another controller
(right to data portability).
These rights are exercised either by sending a letter to the above address, or by e-mail to the e-mail address: info@realmint.ai.
Right to complain
Furthermore, the data subject has the right to appeal to the Personal Data Protection Authority if he considers that his rights are violated in any way. For the
competence of the Authority and the method of submitting a complaint, you can visit its website
(www.dpa.gr - My rights - Submitting a complaint) where detailed information is available.
